goals.label: GATE Mechanical Preparation
goals.description: Formulas, thermal sciences, mechanics of solids, and production engineering problems

goals.label: Automotive & Aerospace R&D
goals.description: Internal combustion, aerodynamics, CAD modeling, structural FEA, and vehicle dynamics

goals.label: Manufacturing & Core PSU Jobs
goals.description: ISRO, DRDO, IOCL, ONGC, BARC, and precision machining industry roles

goals.label: HVAC & Thermal Plant Engineering
goals.description: Psychrometric charts, refrigeration cycles, heat exchangers, and cooling towers

resources.title: Thermodynamics Laws, Cycles & Steam Tables Handbook
resources.description: Original revision sheet covering First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics, Carnot theorem, Otto/Diesel/Rankine cycle derivations, and Mollier diagram usage.
resources.bestFor: Thermodynamics exams and GATE ME formula review

resources.title: Strength of Materials Mohr's Circle & Bending Stresses Guide
resources.description: Original study guide covering Principal Stresses, Mohr's Circle construction, Euler column buckling, and Shear Force / Bending Moment (SFD/BMD) steps.
resources.bestFor: Strength of Materials derivations and midterms

resources.title: Heat Transfer Conduction, Convection & Radiation Formula Reference
resources.description: Original equations sheet for Fourier's Law, critical radius of insulation, lumped capacitance method, dimensionless numbers (Nu, Re, Pr, Gr), and LMTD.
resources.bestFor: Heat Transfer problem solving and numerical exams

resources.title: NPTEL Basic Thermodynamics by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. S. K. Som legendary video lectures covering thermodynamic systems, property relations, entropy generation, and thermodynamic availability.
resources.bestFor: Definitive thermodynamics lectures by Prof. S. K. Som

resources.title: NPTEL Strength of Materials by IIT Madras
resources.description: Prof. M. S. Sivakumar covering stress and strain tensors, Hooke's Law, torsion in circular shafts, and deflection of beams using Macaulay's method.
resources.bestFor: Mechanics of materials and structural calculations

resources.title: NPTEL Fluid Mechanics by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. S. K. Som covering fluid statics, Navier-Stokes equations, Bernoulli equation, boundary layer theory, and pipe flow friction losses.
resources.bestFor: Fluid mechanics foundations and boundary layer theory

resources.title: NPTEL Heat and Mass Transfer by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Lectures on 1D/2D steady heat conduction, fins analysis, convective heat transfer correlations, radiation shape factors, and heat exchangers.
resources.bestFor: Heat transfer calculations and semester curriculum

resources.title: MIT 2.001 Mechanics and Materials I
resources.description: MIT OCW course on stress-strain behavior, trusses, axial loading, torsion, beam bending, and elastic energy methods.

resources.title: MIT 2.005 Thermal-Fluids Engineering I
resources.description: Integrated introduction to thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer with applications to power cycles and cooling.

resources.title: NPTEL Kinematics of Machines by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. A. K. Mallik lectures on mechanisms, kinematic pairs, inversion of four-bar chain, instantaneous center method, and gear trains.
resources.bestFor: Machine theory, links, gears and mechanisms

resources.title: NPTEL Design of Machine Elements by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. B. Maiti covering theories of failure (Tresca, Von Mises), fatigue failure (S-N curve, Goodman diagram), and design of shafts, keys, and couplings.
resources.bestFor: Machine design handbook standards and calculations

resources.title: NPTEL Manufacturing Processes - I by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Lectures covering casting processes (sand casting, investment casting), metal forming (forging, rolling, extrusion), and welding metallurgy.

resources.title: Engineering ToolBox Comprehensive Mechanical Reference
resources.description: Authoritative engineering data sheets, material properties, steam tables, pipe friction factor charts, and HVAC psychrometric values.
resources.bestFor: Material properties, steam tables and design constants

resources.title: NPTEL Refrigeration and Air Conditioning by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. M. Ramgopal lectures on vapor compression refrigeration cycles (VCRC), refrigerants (GWP, ODP), psychrometric processes, and cooling load estimation.
resources.bestFor: HVAC engineering, psychrometry, and refrigeration cycles

resources.title: NPTEL Finite Element Analysis by IIT Madras
resources.description: Prof. B. N. Rao covering variational methods, weighted residual methods, 1D bar/beam elements, 2D CST elements, and stiffness matrix assembly.
resources.bestFor: FEA mathematics and numerical simulation theory
